# Walgreens

> > Walgreens is a leading drugstore chain providing pharmacy services, healthcare clinics, and retail operations, with comprehensive real estate, facilities management, and inclusive employment programs.

This resource covers Walgreens' Property Division operations, including the Unified Design Standards (UDS) for retail design and facilities management, as well as the REDI (Retail Employees Disabilities Initiative) program focused on workplace inclusion and disability employment. The site serves partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders involved in Walgreens' real estate development and human resources initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Walgreens Property Division
- REDI (Retail Employees Disabilities Initiative)
- Unified Design Standards (UDS)
- Facilities Management
- Retail Design
- Healthcare Clinics
- Disability Employment
- Workplace Inclusion
- Real Estate Development
- Distribution Centers
- Design Standards
- Surplus Properties
- Drugstore Chain Operations

## Property Division & Facilities Management

- [Walgreens Facilities](http://facilities.walgreens.com/): Walgreens Property Division portal for design standards and partners
- [Walgreens Property Division](http://facilities.walgreens.com/about.html): About Walgreens Property Division: real estate and facilities management

## Employment & Inclusion Programs

- [Walgreens | REDI](https://extwebapp.walgreens.com/): REDI program: Retail Employees Disabilities Initiative hiring resources
